item.title: About
item.description:
About Me

I started as a frontend developer, working with UI and basic web apps.
Over time, I moved more into backend and data engineering, where I now work with data pipelines and cloud systems.

I enjoy building things that solve real problems — especially backend logic, APIs, and data workflows. I also like clean UI, even though I work more on backend now.

I learn by building things. I usually pick small projects, break them, fix them, and understand how they work.
